title: LibreMicro config
description: Declarative config for the LibreMicro host daemon: per-key launch/colour/notification bindings, modes, and encoder behaviour. Designed to be generated and edited by an AI from this schema.

port.description: Serial port of the CM2, or 'auto' to pick the first /dev/cu.usbmodem*.

brightness.description: Global brightness scale for the addressable LEDs (0-255).

keys.description: Per-key bindings. index 0-12 maps to the 13 physical keys.

modes.description: Named modes. Activating one flashes its key and rebinds the encoder.

default_encoder.description: Encoder binding when no mode is active.

launch.description: macOS app name to open with `open -a` on press.

command.description: Shell command to run on press (alternative to launch).

mode.description: If set, pressing this key activates the named mode instead of launching.

watch.description: A background watcher that pulses this key's LED on external state.

type.description: Watcher kind. 'slack_unread' and 'unread_badge' are examples; the daemon defines the available kinds.

encoder.description: Encoder actions. Values are action tokens the daemon knows (e.g. vol_up, vol_down, play_pause, desk_up, desk_down, stand_sit, or a shell: prefix).
